name: Playwright HAR plus saved scripts, REA offline
description: The gated Camoufox session records a HAR of responses the page itself made, and writes the script bodies to a private temp directory. rea inspect-web-network-capture and static JavaScript analysis read those files. REA never attaches. humanize, the proxy gate and launch_kwargs stay as they are.

name: Playwright HAR only, REA offline
description: Same session, but the only artifact is a HAR. rea inspect-web-network-capture reads it. Scripts are not saved. The derived API surface may omit bodies, headers and query values.

name: Saved scripts only, REA offline
description: The session writes loaded script bytes, in the style of NativeResponseAdapter (listen, do not call). rea analyze-javascript-application reads the directory. No HAR, so request names are whatever the scripts contain as literals.

name: Change REA so it speaks Playwright Firefox / Juggler
description: Patch or wrap rea-agents so its page tools attach to a live Camoufox window over Firefox's protocol instead of Chrome CDP. This is a fork of REA. No public REA provider does this today.

name: Expose Chrome CDP from the Camoufox window
description: Try to make the live Camoufox process accept REA's existing inspect-web-page attach. Camoufox is Firefox. REA's browser contract is Chrome-family CDP.

name: Drive Facebook in Chrome so stock REA can attach
description: Stop using Camoufox for the create page. Use a Chrome-family Playwright browser so rea inspect-web-page can attach. Leaves the humanize float, the cursor, and the Camoufox device pin.

name: Listaro's AdsPower Chromium, REA attached over CDP
description: Open the create page in AdsPower and attach REA with connectOverCDP, as Listaro's poster already attaches Playwright. The account would not pass log-cli's Camoufox gate.

name: Do not add REA; keep the DOM driver
description: Leave publishSession.py and visibleBrowser.py as they are. Selectors stay the ones in docs/listingPublish. No HAR, no script export, no REA process.
